notes: total_flash_bytes is deliberately null: the bare die has no embedded flash at all -- flash is external SPI/QSPI chosen per board, not a chip-level constant like SRAM. Confirmed directly from the datasheet's own chip overview: 'Code may be executed directly from external memory through a dedicated SPI, DSPI or QSPI interface', with no on-die flash anywhere in the memory chapter. Raspberry Pi Pico pairs it with a 2 MB external QSPI flash chip as a board-level choice; other RP2040 boards commonly ship with different external flash sizes, so no single figure would be honest here. total_sram_bytes (264 KB) is confirmed from the same page: 'addressed as a single 264 kB region, but physically partitioned into 6 banks to allow simultaneous parallel access from different masters.' Fetched directly from Raspberry Pi's own datasheets domain, no blocking; 642 pp., relevant sections read in full.
